overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board held a joint meeting to deliberate on zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District, reaching a consensus on building height limits across three sub-districts and establishing regulations for private student housing.

items.title: Hearing 26093: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning Amendments
items.summary: The bodies received presentations on updated definitions for purpose-built student housing and visualized height scenarios for the proposed mixed-use district.

items.title: Presentation on Purpose-Built Student Housing
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt outlined proposed regulations for private dormitories, including on-site management requirements, student-occupancy ratios, and conversion procedures for future multi-family use.

items.title: Presentation on Height Scenarios and Shadow Studies
items.summary: Innes Associates presented multiple height and density options for sub-districts BA1, BA2, and BA3, supported by shadow studies for winter and summer solstices.

items.title: Public Comment Session
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns regarding excessive building heights in BA3, potential traffic congestion, and the impact of concentrated student housing on residential neighborhoods.

items.title: Approval of BA1 Height Limits
items.summary: Approved Option A, setting building heights at three base stories with one incentive story.

items.title: Approval of BA2 Height Limits
items.summary: Approved Option C, allowing four base stories with three incentive stories in the district center and three base stories with one incentive story on side parcels, with an added six-foot minimum setback requirement for Winchester Street.

items.title: Approval of BA3 Height Limits
items.summary: Approved Option A, setting building heights at five base stories with two incentive stories.

items.title: Affordability Incentive and Student Housing Definitions
items.summary: Approved the definition and standards for purpose-built student housing and directed staff to fix technical errors in the affordability incentive calculations for small-scale projects.

items.title: Motion to Close Public Hearing
items.summary: The public hearing was closed by both bodies, with the Community Development Board planning a final working session in August to consolidate recommendations into a final text for Council ordainment.

subject: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning Amendments
